description: §55.1 — the presence validator `<nick is given length(>=3)>` declares the cell and composes: typing "ab" leaves a present value, so `is given` passes (no short-circuit) and `length(>=3)` fails — #all renders one .scrml-error, isValid false. The canonical twin of forms/is-some-deprecated-validator (same runtime, no W-IS-SOME-DEPRECATED).
rationale: §55.1 — `is given` is the universal-core existence predicate (absence fails; a present value passes); §55.12 — it short-circuits only when it fails. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a, validator too, go".
